delivered: The Windows app's Golden File Explorer browses the saved project folder or its Project Folder override, offers Tree and Thumbnail Views, and drags native paths into the same MapGyver destinations as desktop file drops.

checks.software: Five focused tests passed for folder resolution, bounded paging, root containment, PNG thumbnail output, and the existing Matrix and Media import intents. Generated desktop bindings, Svelte checks, Windows app build, strict Clippy and formatting passed.
checks.native: The bundled WebView2 app loaded a project from its default folder, expanded a nested Tree View branch, rendered a decoded local PNG in Thumbnail View and navigated back. Editing the typed settings changed the root, and the folder button dispatched the native directory-picking command. Its returned override persisted across New and reload. A panel-to-Medias drag with an accented filename produced Picture Media with the exact disk path and supported one-step Undo.

limits: Thumbnail View decodes PNG, JPEG and WebP and shows file icons for other types. The folder-button test supplied the picker response over the app's IPC contract. Direct Windows dialog input was unavailable because the Computer Use native pipe did not connect. The M18/1 direct Windows File Explorer drag checks remain pending.
progress: One verified gate advances to 121/145 (83% rounded) and M18 reaches 2/6.
